name: PathogenicMatrix
description: Read-only run observer for the Pathogenic Matrix companion app. Emits your build, reward/shop/level-up choices and a session log as local JSON.

godot.description_rich: Writes user://matrix_state.json and user://matrix_logs/*.jsonl, and optionally POSTs state to http://127.0.0.1:48710/state. Never changes game state.
